newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU crude stocks rise in April, while products fall.
newsitem.headline: EU crude stocks rise in April, while products fall.

text.p: Crude oil stocks in the 15 countries of the European Union plus Norway rose in April while oil product stocks fell, Stitching Euroilstock said in its latest monthly report.
Crude and oil product stocks combined rose by 2.11 million barrels, or 0.2 percent, to 1,083.55 million barrels at the end of April, because of a sharp rise of crude levels.
Crude oil stocks were up 13.00 million barrels, or 3.1 percent, in April to 427.42 million barrels, but this still left them 50,000 barrels lower than year-ago levels.
Gasoline inventories dropped by 5.35 million barrels, or 3.1 percent, in April to 168.73 million barrels and were 1.70 million barrels, or 1.0 percent, lower than a year ago.
Middle distillate stocks fell by 6.60 million barrels, or 2.1 percent, to 311.48 million barrels. This left them 11.89 million barrels, or 4.0 percent, higher than a year ago.
Fuel oil stocks were 260,000 barrels, or 0.2 percent, lower in April at 148.20 million barrels. This left a year-on-year surplus of 9.63 million barrels, or 6.9 percent.
Naphtha stocks rose by 1.32 million barrels to 27.72 million barrels at the end of April.
Crude intake was 660,000 barrels per day (bpd), or 5.8 percent, higher than in March at 11.957 million bpd, leading to a utilisation rate of 90.58 percent in April.
A full inventory list, including country-by-country, in barrels and tonnes, is on Reuters pages EUROILA to EUROILJ.
